_summary.note: M-side Bochner via Lasserre-lifted bilinears (mside_via_lasserre.py): exact-bilinear encoding (|f̂(m)|² = (M_top[m,m] + M_top[T_max+m,T_max+m])/4, no slack) of Hermitian-Toeplitz PSD T_M ⪰ 0. Δ over baseline (f-side Bochner + Lasserre): n_M=10 gives +8e-7, n_M=20 gives +2.7e-6 — non-zero (~1000× larger than the SOC-relaxed mside_bochner.py result of +1.65e-8 at n_M=10) but well below the +1e-5 practical cancel threshold. Status remained `optimal_inaccurate` (no infeasibility from sign error), confirming the encoding is valid but the constraint is essentially redundant once Lasserre-2 is in place. NEGATIVE practical result: the M-Toeplitz PSD content is implicitly enforced by Lasserre-2's localizing PSD on (f-f^2). No scale-up to N=10000 warranted (Δ < +1e-5).
